hard_compare: run hard checkers on agent and oracle arguments and return pass or fail with rationale
soft_compare: run soft LLM-based checkers on agent and oracle arguments for semantic validation
mild_compare: run combined hard and soft comparison on agent and oracle events with rationale
build_llm_checkers: build all LLM checker instances for soft checking with configurable majority vote count
normalize_arg: normalize an argument string by lowercasing removing accents and stripping punctuation for comparison
